commit.description: Messages for the commits Frog makes on your behalf.

link.description: Message for the commit writing an entry's issue link onto its pull request.

sync.description: Message for the commit reconciling the log against issue state.

inbound.description: Whether and how this repository accepts friction reported by others.

allowFrom.description: Sender repositories, or `owner/*` globs, allowed to report friction here. Absent means anyone.

enabled.description: Accept friction reported by other repositories.

labels.description: Labels applied to inbound issues, in place of `labels`.

template.description: Issue form reported friction is written against, as a path or a filename under `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`. Absent looks for `friction.yml`, then the only form there.

labels.description: Labels applied to every issue this repository files about itself.

maxPerRun.description: Ceiling on issues filed in one publish run, or in one webhook delivery. A second delivery gets its own allowance, and anything over the ceiling is deferred rather than dropped.

outbound.description: Where friction may be reported, and whether automation may do it unattended.

allowedRepos.description: Targets this repository may file against. Always read from the base branch, never a pull request head.

enabled.description: Report friction to other repositories. Off refuses every target but this one.

pullRequest.description: Reconcile a closed or reopened issue through a pull request. An object names the branch it is opened from. Set `false` to commit straight to the default branch instead, which needs no merge but fails where that branch is protected.

repo.description: `owner/name` this repository's own friction is filed against. Defaults to the origin remote.
